sentences.text: Chaoyangia is known from a single partial skeleton that includes vertebrae, ribs, hips, and upper legs.
Chaoyangia beishanensis was discovered in the Jiufotang Formation near Chaoyang in Liaoning province, China.
The species was originally placed in its own order, Chaoyangiformes, by its describer Hou.
A 2012 study confirmed that Chaoyangia is a primitive euornithean (ornithuran) based on phylogenetic analysis.
Chaoyangia is classified within the parent group Ornithuromorpha.
Chaoyangia lived during the Aptian age of the Early Cretaceous period, approximately 120 million years ago.
Some researchers have debated whether Chaoyangia and Songlingornis are synonyms after Songlingornis was removed from the genus.
